_**User**_

Please confirm that the following has been done to the site and tell me your plans for the items in this list that have yet to be done:  Donation Page / Donate Button

Remove the music from the donation page.
The Donate button needs to lead directly to a functioning and secure payment/donation page so someone can actually complete their donation online. Will send you over what type of link we will use. 

501(c)(3) Status


Triple H Healthcare Services has been officially recognized by the IRS as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
Please make sure the appropriate 501(c)(3) language is clearly reflected on the website, particularly around the donation area.
Insurance Wording
Change the insurance language so we are not making a guarantee that someone’s insurance will cover our services.
Suggested wording:
“Insurance coverage may be available for eligible services.”
Statistics Section



Let’s review and update the statistics currently displayed on the website.
We want to make sure any numbers regarding communities served, services provided, hours, impact, or similar statistics are accurate and can be supported.
If a statistic cannot currently be verified, let’s either replace it with something we can verify or remove it for now.
Address


Please make sure the address is updated to:
1402 Carrollton Parkway, #2088
Carrollton, TX  ( Already changed )

Four Core Services


Update/revise the four core service components so they accurately represent the services Triple H Healthcare Services provides.
Please also make sure the descriptions underneath each service are clean, consistent, and grammatically correct.
Why Us Section


Give the “Why Us” section one final review for wording, grammar, and presentation.
We want this section to clearly communicate what separates Triple H from other healthcare service organizations.
Final Grammar & Website Cleanup


Please do one final review of the entire website for spelling, grammar, punctuation, spacing, and consistency.
Pay particular attention to the service descriptions and any areas where wording may need to be cleaned up.
Mobile & Desktop Testing
Please check the website on both mobile and desktop to make sure everything displays correctly.
Test all buttons and links to make sure they are going to the correct places.
Contact Form
Please test the contact form one final time and make sure submissions are being received correctly.

I added a "Support Our Mission" section with the Zelle QR code to the home page, just above Contact. All three Donate links (header, footer, and the Our Story page) now go to it. The production build passes, and in the browser each link landed on the section, right below the fixed header.

![Donate section on mobile](c:\Users\terra\AppData\Local\Temp\cursor\screenshots\donate-mobile-section.png)

**What's in the section**
- The 501(c)(3) statement, moved here from the footer so the page has only one donate target.
- The QR code in a white card. I cropped the empty margins off your image and saved it as `public/assets/img/zelle-qr.png`; otherwise the code would have been too small to scan at the display size.
- "Donate with Zelle" steps, including checking that the recipient shows as TRIPLE H HEALTH CARE SERVICES and adding a name and email in the memo so Triple H can send a receipt.
- A note for phone visitors that they can't scan a code on the same phone showing it, with a link to the contact form.

**Two scrolling fixes**
- **Links from the Our Story page:** they reached the home page but stopped too high, because images above the section loaded after the scroll and pushed it down. The header now scrolls again once those images finish loading, in `components/Header.js`. This also fixes the Services and Contact links from that page.
- **Footer link on the home page:** it scrolled the section under the fixed header. A small CSS rule in `app/globals.css` now offsets these jumps for every section.

I also removed the unused donation URL setting from `.env.example` and the README, since Donate now always points to this section.

On mobile the QR card fits the screen with the steps below it. On desktop the card and steps sit side by side with no horizontal overflow; I checked that by measuring the layout, because the browser panel was too narrow to screenshot at desktop width.

The changes aren't deployed yet. Once they're live, it's worth scanning the code from the live site with a real banking app before announcing it.

All the SEO work is finished. I tested it on a local production build and every check passed: the build succeeded, there are no linter errors, and nothing has been committed.

**What the site now does for search engines**
- **Titles and descriptions:** The home page title is "Holistic Wellness and Recovery Support in Carrollton, TX | Healing Helping Hands", and the Our Story page is "Our Story | Healing Helping Hands". Each page has its own description mentioning Carrollton and Dallas-Fort Worth.
- **Canonical addresses:** Every page tells Google its official address is on `https://triplehhealthservices.com`. Requests to the `.org` domain or the `www` versions are permanently redirected to that address; I confirmed this for `.org` locally.
- **Sitemap and robots file:** `/sitemap.xml` lists both pages. `/robots.txt` lets search engines crawl everything except `/api/` and points them to the sitemap.
- **Structured data:** Every page includes a machine-readable description of the organization for Google, marking it as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. It includes the Carrollton address, phone, email, service area and the four core services.
- **Link previews:** Shared links on Facebook, iMessage, LinkedIn and X show a new 1200x630 preview image. It has the logo, the tagline, "Carrollton and Dallas-Fort Worth, TX" and "501(c)(3) NONPROFIT".
- **Page content:**
  - Each page now has exactly one main heading. On the home page it's "Holistic Wellness and Recovery Support in Carrollton, TX".
  - The page text and the contact section mention the local area.
  - Images have descriptive alt text and set sizes.

I checked the headings in the browser: they look the same as before, and nothing spills off the side on a narrow screen.

**Steps for the site owner after deploying**
1. **Vercel:** Make sure `triplehhealthservices.com` is set as the primary domain, and that `www` and `.org` are added as domains so the redirects take effect.
2. **Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools:** Verify the `.com` domain and submit `https://triplehhealthservices.com/sitemap.xml`.
3. **Google Business Profile:** Create or claim the listing at 1402 Carrollton Parkway #2088 with the same name, phone and website. For local searches, this matters more than anything on the site itself.
4. **Other listings** (Yelp, GuideStar/Candid, nonprofit directories): Use exactly the same name, address and phone as the site.
5. **Validate:** Run the live URL through [Google's Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results), and check a shared link with a preview tool such as [opengraph.xyz](https://www.opengraph.xyz/).

Rankings usually take a few weeks to respond once Google recrawls the site.

_**Agent (default)**_

Yes, but it isn't a physical `sitemap.xml` file. I added `app/sitemap.js`, and Next.js turns it into `/sitemap.xml` at build time. After you deploy, it will be at `https://triplehhealthservices.com/sitemap.xml`.

In the local production build, it listed both pages:
- `https://triplehhealthservices.com` (home page, top priority, marked as changing monthly)
- `https://triplehhealthservices.com/our-story` (marked as changing yearly)

`/robots.txt` is generated from `app/robots.js` the same way, and it points search engines to the sitemap. Generating it this way means the domain comes from `lib/site.js`, so it can't get out of sync with the site. When you add a page later, add it to `app/sitemap.js`.

When you submit the sitemap in Google Search Console, just enter `sitemap.xml`.

I added a Venmo option to the Donate section. Its button opens `https://venmo.com/u/Triplehhealthcare`; on a phone this usually opens the Venmo app, and on a computer it opens the Venmo website. I checked it on a local test server, and there are no linter errors.

![Venmo donation block](c:\Users\terra\AppData\Local\Temp\cursor\screenshots\venmo-section.png)

**What changed**
- **Venmo block:** It sits below the Zelle QR code and instructions. It has a "Donate with Venmo" heading, the handle **@Triplehhealthcare**, a note asking donors to add their name and email for a receipt, and a blue button that opens Venmo in a new tab.
- **Phone note:** The Zelle note now says "Use Venmo below" as the first option, since Venmo works on the same phone that's showing the page.
- **Where the handle lives:** It's stored once in `lib/site.js` as `venmoHandle`, so it only needs changing in one place. The new styles are in `app/globals.css`.

**Two problems on the Venmo profile in your screenshot**
1. **Wrong website address:** The profile lists `www.triplehhealthservice.com`, which is missing the "s" at the end. It should be `https://triplehhealthservices.com`. Fix this in the Venmo app's profile settings so donors aren't sent to the wrong address.
2. **Business profile:** It's listed under "Medical Services and Health Practitioners". Venmo has a separate charity profile for verified 501(c)(3) organizations, and nonprofits often switch to it.

**Instagram handle**

The Venmo profile also shows the Instagram account @triplehhealthservices. I can add it to the site footer and to the organization information Google reads, which helps Google connect the accounts. Just say if you'd like that.

SUPPORT OUR MISSION

Your Donation Makes a Difference

At Healing Helping Hands (Triple H), we believe recovery is about more than medical treatment. It’s also about restoring hope, confidence, dignity, and a sense of normalcy during some of life’s most difficult moments.

Your contribution helps us provide supportive wellness, personal-care, and uplifting experiences for individuals and families navigating short- and long-term recovery.

Whether someone is recovering from a serious injury, illness, extended hospitalization, or rehabilitation, our goal is simple: help make the journey a little easier and remind people that they are not alone.

WHERE YOUR SUPPORT GOES

Donations help support wellness and personal-care services, patient and family support, programs promoting confidence and emotional well-being, special experiences and entertainment, and community outreach initiatives.

EVERY CONTRIBUTION MATTERS

Whether someone gives $25, $50, $100, $500, or more, every contribution helps us continue expanding our reach and providing meaningful support to people throughout their recovery journey.

Together, we can help turn difficult days into better ones.

DONATE NOW

Healing Helping Hands is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Contributions are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law.

Please keep the existing Zelle and Venmo information and QR codes. For Zelle, please continue to clearly state that donors should verify the recipient displays as TRIPLE H HEALTH CARE SERVICES before submitting their donation.

CORPORATE & COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS

Contact us to discuss partnership opportunities.

THANK YOU FOR HELPING US HELP OTHERS

Your support allows Healing Helping Hands to continue bringing care, encouragement, dignity, and hope to people facing challenging recovery journeys.

Healing. Helping. Hope.

Thank you!

  "plan": "# Services Spacing and Location-Neutral Wording\n\n## 1. The service text now stays inside the margins on phone, tablet and desktop, and all service-area wording is gone. The only place Carrollton and TX still appear is the mailing address, which you chose to keep. I measured the layout at 360px, 768px and 1280px widths, and there are no linter errors. Nothing is committed yet.

![Longest service slide on a phone](c:\Users\terra\AppData\Local\Temp\cursor\screenshots\hero-mobile.png)

**Spacing fixes**

The service text ran past the edges in three places:
- **Carousel slides at the top of the page:** the text area had no side padding, so long titles like "Mental Health and Emotional Wellness Services" ran edge to edge and under the arrow buttons. The text area now has side padding that grows with the arrow buttons, and titles shrink smoothly from 48px on desktop to 24px on small phones. On every slide, all text now clears the arrows at every width I checked.
- **Services list in the About section:** this was the main bleed on phones. That column had its left padding removed, so the service names and descriptions touched the left edge of the screen. I restored the padding, and the text now sits 24px from each edge on a 360px phone.
- **Contact section:** I also fixed a problem I found there. The long email address, `infotriplehhealthcareservices@gmail.com`, pushed past the right edge on tablets and caused sideways scrolling. It now wraps.

These changes are in `app/globals.css`, plus a one-class change in `app/page.js`.

**Wording changes**

The service descriptions themselves are unchanged.
- **Main heading:** now "Holistic Wellness and Recovery Support".
- **About paragraph:** now "...to individuals and families in need of compassionate, dependable care during short- and long-term recovery."
- **Contact intro:** now "We provide compassionate, dependable care to individuals and families in need."
- **Behind the scenes:**
  - The browser tab title, the Google description and the Our Story page description no longer mention a location.
  - The service-area list was removed from the business information Google reads.
  - The link-preview image now says "Compassionate, dependable care for individuals and families" instead of "Carrollton and Dallas-Fort Worth, TX".

![New link preview image](c:\Users\terra\Projects\ChenellHickey\TripleHHH\public\assets\img\og-image.jpg)

Google and social sites may keep showing the old title and preview for a while after you deploy, until they revisit the site.
